blocks.text:
Inherited from Proto-Slavic *dělo, from Proto-Slavic *děti, from Proto-Indo-European *dʰeh₁-, whence English do, deed, deem, doom, and via Latin, fact and affair.

Other cognates include, via Ancient Greek, English theme, thesis, Sanskrit दधाति (“to put”) Sanskrit धातृ (“creator”) and धातु (“layer, element, root”).

rows: to become, to get, to grow, to turn; to happen (with, to), to be going on
to affect, to have an effect on
reliable, dependable, trustworthy; firm, safe, sure
doer, actor, agent (one who acts; a doer); (famous) figure, personality
deed, act, action, exploit (heroic or extraordinary deed)
